name: Cultural Convergence
description: Cultures spread and take root. Identity becomes destiny.

prose.setup_to_escalation: Three mortals claim identity within new cultures. Belonging takes shape—a root deeper than flesh and blood.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: Six souls now carry cultural identity. Heritage spreads through bloodlines and choice alike. Convergence is inevitable now.
prose.completed: Ten cultural bonds trace themselves through the realm. Identity has become destiny. The Convergence is written into being itself.
prose.failed: The cultures fail to take root. Identity remains fractured and scattered. People resist the shape you were trying to impose.
